title: Sea View at WaterSound Crossings | Royal Destinations
meta_description: 30A Gulf Front Luxury Condo with Panoramic Views + Great Amenities - Sea View at WaterSound Crossings by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Sea View at WaterSound Crossings by Royal Destinations Location: WaterSound Address: 100 S Bridge Ln Unit C 213, WaterSound, FL 32461 Details: Sea View at WaterSound Crossings is an exceptional coastal escape and one of the most sought-after WaterSound vacation rentals along Scenic 30A. Designed for unforgettable family vacations, this stunning three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath residence combines comfort, space, and breathtaking scenery (everything guests look for in luxury 30A rentals). Located in a Gulf front building, Sea View stands out among 30A Gulf front rentals with panoramic views of the Emerald Coast and easy access to the sugar-white sand just steps away. From the moment you arrive, the sweeping Gulf views and coastal elegance make it clear why travelers consistently choose luxury beachfront rentals for their beach getaway. The spacious private balcony offers front-row seats to the beauty of the Gulf, perfect for morning coffee while the waves roll in or evening gatherings as the sky fills with the bold, brilliant colors of a 30A sunset. With its incredible views, ideal family layout, and unbeatable location, Sea View is truly a standout among 30A luxury vacation rentals. Royal Destinations looks forward to welcoming your family to Sea View at WaterSound Crossings for an unforgettable stay along the Emerald Coast. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Panoramic Gulf views. - Gulf front building just steps from the sugar-white sand. - Spacious balcony overlooking the Gulf. - Private beach access only a five-minute walk away. - Community pool with grill for relaxed afternoons and cookouts. - Dining table with seating for six. - Beach towel service provided for your convenience. - Elevator access for easy arrivals and beach days. - Two dedicated parking spaces (parking pass required). - Coffee maker available for easy mornings. WaterSound Community Highlights: - Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach - 2 Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate) - Kayak Rentals - Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks - Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach - A short walk to The Big Chill *Please Note: Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. WaterSound does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 6 3 Bedrooms / 3.5 Baths One Floor: - Bedroom 1: (En Suite): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub), Porch, Panoramic Views - Bedroom 2: (En Suite): Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) - Bedroom 3: (En Suite): Two Twin Beds with Private Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) - Open Floor Plan Encompassing Living, Dining, Kitchen and Outdoor Porch - Half Bath - Laundry Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
